summarize_v1.template_str:
Summarise the following text in exactly $max_sentences sentence(s).
Be concise and factual. Do not add information not present in the text.

$text
summarize_v1.description: Summarise a text passage in a fixed number of sentences.

classify_v1.template_str:
Classify the text below as exactly one of: $categories.
Reply with the category label only — no punctuation, no explanation.

$text
classify_v1.description: Classify text into exactly one of the given categories.

extract_v1.template_str:
Extract all ${entity_type}s from the text below.
Return a JSON array of strings — no other text.

$text
extract_v1.description: Extract all instances of a named entity type as a JSON array.
